commit.message: Modify App to render NavScreen
Refactor common styles into variables
Use customization features of components
Make VariableTable component more customizable
Make the variable component more customizable
Rename viewStyle to topStyle

Restyle variables

* Give each variable a bottom border
* Resize the different components of a variable
* Recolor each component
* Center everything properly
Minor refactor
Make calculator's body more customizable
Make the IO Display screen more customizable

Refactor

Rename `textInputProps` variable to the more appropriate
`ioDisplayProps`.

Fix bug in `decideParen` function

The function used 'X' to denote the multiplcation symbol instead of '*'.
Add navigation screen to navigate between calculator and variables

Fix bug in parentheses key

Parentheses key would delete the entire input and replace it with just
a signle close paren. This has been fixed.
Install @react-navigation/native
Install dependencies for react-navigation

Add a VariableTable component

The VariableTable component renders a collection of Variable
components.

Add a Variable component

The Variable component represents a row that displays a variable's
name and value, and has buttons to use or delete the variable.
Fix bug which disabled numeric buttons
Refactor inline button callbacks into functions
Allow default touch action on a button be nothing

Refactor

* Remove unused imports
* Remove unnecessary use of commas
Implement the '=' button
Install Axios
Use * for multiplication instead of X

Replace viewport based dimensions with percentages

Viewport based dimensions (vh and vw) cause a crash on Android.
Show the CalculatorView on the main screen
Make IO area horizontally scrollable
Style the IO area of the calculator

Make Buttons functional

Most buttons echo to IO area while special buttons perform certain
actions.
